name: Add to Cart Button Customizer – SmallEasyTools
author: monirul1010

sections.description:
Add to Cart Button Customizer – SmallEasyTools is a lightweight WooCommerce plugin that allows store owners to customize the Add to Cart button without writing any code.

By default, WooCommerce uses a fixed “Add to Cart” button text and style. This plugin allows you to easily change the button text and design globally from the WordPress settings panel.

With this plugin you can:

  • Change the Add to Cart button text
  • Add a cart icon before the button text
  • Change the button background color
  • Change the button text color
  • Add customizable button borders and border colors
  • Set hover background color
  • Set hover text color
  • Control button size (Small / Normal / Large)
  • Reset settings instantly
  • Use WordPress color picker or custom HEX codes

All changes are applied globally across your WooCommerce store.

The plugin is extremely lightweight and does not slow down your website.

Features

  • Change WooCommerce Add to Cart button text globally
  • Add optional cart icons before button text
  • Customize button background color
  • Customize button text color
  • Customize button border style and border color
  • Customize hover background color
  • Customize hover text color
  • Button size control (Small / Normal / Large)
  • Built-in WordPress color picker
  • Supports custom HEX color codes
  • Simple settings page
  • Reset button for quick default restore
  • Lightweight and optimized
  • Clean and secure code

Author

Developed by Monirul

Website: https://www.smalleasytools.net
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins page
  3. Go to Settings → Cart Button Customizer
  4. Enter your custom button text
  5. Customize colors, hover colors, icons or button size
  6. Click Save Changes

Your WooCommerce Add to Cart button will update instantly.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. This plugin works only with WooCommerce because it customizes the WooCommerce Add to Cart button.

Can I change the Add to Cart button text?

Yes. You can replace the default WooCommerce “Add to Cart” text with any custom text directly from the plugin settings page.

Can I change the button color?

Yes. You can change both the button background color and the button text color using the built-in WordPress color picker.

Can I add hover effects to the button?

Yes. The plugin allows you to set custom hover background color and hover text color for the Add to Cart button.

Can I use custom HEX colors?

Yes. You can either use the color picker or manually enter HEX color codes.

Example:

ffffff

Can I add an icon to the Add to Cart button?

Yes. You can add a cart icon or plus icon before the button text from the settings page.

Can I change the button size?

Yes. The plugin includes three size options:

Small
Normal
Large

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin is extremely lightweight and only adds a small amount of CSS and settings functionality.

Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes. The plugin uses WooCommerce filters and standard CSS selectors so it works with most WooCommerce themes.

Is the plugin beginner friendly?

Yes. No coding is required. All customization can be done directly from the WordPress dashboard.

Can I reset the settings?

Yes. The plugin includes a Reset button which restores the default settings instantly.
